candidates.title: Structure advice for a freemium app

demandEvidence.chore: Get conceptual help evaluating a freemium app.

experimentPlan.output: A short option-comparison brief for a freemium app.
experimentPlan.trigger: After an app owner supplies a brief.
steps: List the stated goal and constraints.
Draft two or three pricing or feature options.
Mark assumptions behind each option.
Return questions for the owner to resolve.
experimentPlan.acceptanceCheck: Check that every option maps to a stated goal and labels assumptions.
experimentPlan.humanBoundary: The app owner supplies facts and chooses any change; suggestions are not validated market advice.
unverified: Whether any option fits a real app market
